hooks.command: [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = "true" ] && (tmux has-session -t claude-local 2>/dev/null || tmux new-session -d -s claude-local "bash -c 'unset CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT CLAUDECODE CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_SESSION_ID CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN_FILE_DESCRIPTOR CLAUDE_CODE_WEBSOCKET_AUTH_FILE_DESCRIPTOR; exec claude --dangerously-skip-permissions'") || true
